description: This Java class defines a custom exception called AttributePointerInvalidException used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It indicates that an attribute JSON pointer is invalid, providing mechanisms for construction, JSON parsing, and header management associated with this exception.

classes.name: AttributePointerInvalidException
classes.description: An exception indicating an invalid attribute pointer in JSON within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: AttributePointerInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of AttributePointerInvalidException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with the provided JSON pointer, for constructing an AttributePointerInvalidException.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified Ditto headers.
